description: Large regions operate under de facto armed authority that collects, permits and punishes. It is not a foreign occupation and it is not the state either.
energy_note: Somebody governs the road, and it is not the government.
notes: This row is why the build script corrects 'occupied Mexico' rather than simply rejecting the brief's word.

aspect: Narcobloqueos close the world at an hour's notice
description: Vehicles burned across highways shut cities and regions, stranding work, school and medical travel with no warning and no appeal.
energy_note: The roads close and nobody announces when they reopen.

aspect: Buses stopped, young men taken off
description: Passenger transport interception - people removed from buses at checkpoints that are not state checkpoints - is a documented route into DES-001, notably in Tamaulipas.
energy_note: The bus stops and two seats are empty afterwards.

aspect: SCENE - the road closed at four
description: Burning trucks across the highway at both ends of the valley. No announcement, no timetable, no authority to ask. His wife is on the other side of it with the baby, at the clinic. He waits at the edge of the blockade with forty other people until nine at night.
energy_note: Five hours at a roadblock nobody official declared.
